caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden mailbox with a peaked roof and a rectangular body, shown in three-quarter view. The mailbox is rendered in colored pencil or a similar medium, with varying shades of green and hints of brown to suggest the texture and grain of wood. The roof is triangular with a slanted top, and the front portion of the box includes a hinged lid that is slightly open, revealing the interior, which appears empty. All sides of the mailbox are visible except the back, with the left and top surfaces more prominently lit and the underside shaded. The box sits on a plain, unadorned background with light pencil framing lines near the edges. Handwritten text at the bottom center reads "MAIL BOX 1940" followed by "SCALE 2"= 1 FT." and there is a small signature on the lower right corner.
title: Mail Box
